plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence for the Certificate of Achievement, published in the 2023-2024 catalog (pp. 100-101). Sequenced sum is 25, matching the catalog's 'Total Units Required for Major/Certificate: 25'. AUTOB 16 carries the catalog hard prerequisite 'AUTOB 10 or AUTOB 30'; AUTOB 30 precedes it in this plan, so prereq is coded as AUTOB 30. AUTOB 40's 'Recommended preparation: AUTOB 30' is not a hard prerequisite and is not coded. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
